notes.title: Act 3 Update - v0.753 Now Live
notes.notes:
Act 3 is now live on Early Access for everyone to enjoy. Many thanks for those that took part in private beta testing it the last few weeks.

One of the changes that I'd like to highlight is the removal of the visible Objectives List. Due to the nature of the game, it felt like it wasn't required and there was enough information in the game from reading items or discovering them to know what you need to do next. In addition, telling players what to do in a linear way ruined the whole exploration side of things I want to aim for. On that note, here is a very brief list of changes.

[b]v0.753 Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 brand new dungeons for Act 3
[*] Several new enemies for the new dungeons
[*] Difficulty balancing across the game
[*] Removed the Objectives list from the Journal
[*] Additional puzzles in the House
[*] Extra lore to find and read in the House
[*] Mouse sensitivity settings in options
[*] Many bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

NOTE: It is highly recommended that you start a New Game due to the many changes

notes.title: Patch v0.746b
notes.notes:
Apologies if this has impacted on your experience but I believe I have a potential fix for the duplication bug of items in the House. 

However, if you have picked up any of the duplicate items. I would [b]recommend[/b] that you start a NEW GAME. If you didn't pick up any of the duplicates then your save game should be fine.

Here are a list of items that could be duplicated:

[list]
[*] Basic Crucifix
[*] Skull Ornament
[*] Small Bell
[*] Glass Eye (Blue)
[*] Crystal (Green)
[*] Door Handle
[*] Toy Cube 1, 2 and 4
[/list]

[b][u]NOTE:[/u][/b] If you have any second copies of any of the above (Toy Cube 3 is ok) I would suggest starting a new game once you have updated to v0.746b.

Once again, I do apologise for impacting on your experience :)

notes.title: Patch Rollback to v0.774b

Due to a crash on windows builds for some people, I have decided to rollback this mornings patch v0.745 to v0.744b.

I need to investigate the problem so in the meantime, I have done a rollback t not interrupt your gameplay :) sorry for the inconvenience.
